summary: No structure changes proposed for PushA. LegsB was finally logged in full on 2026-10-05 (leg curl 3, hip machines 2 each, calves 3, cable crunch 3), which closes last night's open question about whether the eight-slot layout is workable: it is. PushA itself runs seven slots and 20 sets with no lateral raise (removed 2026-09-11 on his decision, lateral work lives on PushB at 4 sets). The last PushA on record is 2026-09-25 and it was logged short (machine chest press 2 of 3, shoulder press 2 of 3), which is one shortened session, not a composition signal. Calendar: meso3 build week 2 of 4.

Planned 3 sets of 10-12 here against 4 sets of 8-10 on PushB, so shoulders get the heavier work on PushB. Full 3 sets on 2026-09-19, 2 on 2026-09-25. No change.
Planned 3 sets of 12-15 and the only rear-shoulder work on PushA, balancing the pressing on this day. 3 sets on 2026-09-19, 2 on 2026-09-25. No change.

Planned 3 sets of 10-12 for triceps after all the pressing. 3 sets on 2026-09-19, 2 on 2026-09-25. The dossier lists it as stalled, which is the progression trainer question, not a composition one. No change.

Planned 2 sets of 12-15 as the last slot, pairing a shortened-position triceps lift with the long-head overhead lift. 2 sets on 2026-09-19, 1 on 2026-09-25, so the tail slot is the one that gets dropped on short days. Worth knowing, but one short session is not enough to cut it. No change.
